detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action, Ferrier's farm, Utah, 1860, low side sun, deep black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:04. The shot begins from <Picture 4>: a medium close shot on <Subject 1> inside the doorway, head and shoulders, in the brown felt hat with the brim's black across his eyes and the fawn coat open, the long sun-darkened face and iron-grey beard, the low sun from the right on one side of the face, the riding whip in his hand at the bottom of frame, the black room behind him. The camera is on the threshold level with John Ferrier's eye, an arm's length from him, a 50mm lens. The low sun comes from the right onto his near cheek under the hat brim. At the first frame John Ferrier's head and shoulders fill the CENTRE of the frame from the TOP edge to the fawn coat at the BOTTOM third. The camera pushes in on <Subject 1> across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as his head turns a hand's breadth to follow the man out of the door, from 00:00 to 00:02. At 00:02 his hand tightens on the riding whip and draws it up against his chest at a normal trot, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:04 the camera is pushing in on <Subject 1> across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth through the last frame of the shot, and the action continues with it.
[Shot 2] From 00:04 to 00:08. At 00:04 the shot cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 2>'s black-coated back going away down the shingly path, beginning from <Picture 5>: seen low from the porch boards, his boots and swinging coat skirts big in the frame, the low sun from the left on his sandy head. The camera is on the porch boards at the height of a man's knee, three long strides behind him, a 35mm lens. The low sun comes from the left and lights his head and shoulder. At the first frame Brigham Young's black back fills the CENTRE of the frame from the boots at the bottom edge to the sandy head at the TOP third. The camera pushes in on <Subject 2>'s back across the whole shot, travelling one long stride as he walks away down the path at a normal walking pace as the shingle turns under his heavy boots, from 00:04 to 00:06. At 00:06 his black coat skirts swing at the knee, and the swing continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 2>'s mouth is closed from 00:04 to 00:08 while his black coat skirts swing at the knee. By 00:08 the camera is pushing in on <Subject 2>'s back across the whole shot, travelling one long stride as he walks away down the path at a normal walking pace through the last frame of the shot, and the action continues with it.
